skill.name: dbs-learning
skill.description: 把课题拆成连续学习文章，并根据用户反馈调整后续深度、角度和节奏。用户要求系统学习一个主题、继续下一篇或按反馈调整课程时使用。
skill.summary: Create sequential Chinese learning articles that adapt to learner feedback and maintain local progress records.
skill.author: dontbesilent2025

No evidence found of credential extraction, hidden executable content, or instructions to override the audit. The documented workflow reads scoped learning materials and writes local lesson files.

content.user_title: Build Adaptive Learning Series in Chinese
content.value_statement: Fixed courses can miss your existing knowledge and leave unclear concepts unresolved. This skill creates Chinese lesson sequences and adjusts later articles using your feedback.
actual_capabilities: Create a topic directory, learning plan, numbered Markdown lessons, and an assets directory.
Offer project-based, beginner, or specified-material learning modes when relevant project evidence exists.
Summarize candidate knowledge from a small set of relevant project materials without treating every document as proof of understanding.
Extract learner-written feedback while excluding default template questions.
Adjust lesson depth, examples, pace, and application focus according to the latest feedback.
Update learning progress, feedback summaries, next-lesson direction, and an index when used.
limitations: The skill requires Chinese lesson output and does not provide a multilingual teaching workflow.
It requires an AI assistant with local file access to maintain lesson files and progress.
It does not perform business diagnosis or standalone content ghostwriting.
It uses feedback and visible materials to estimate understanding; it does not provide objective mastery testing or guaranteed factual accuracy.

use_cases.title: Start a Structured Self-Study Topic
use_cases.description: Build a Chinese lesson sequence from the beginning, then adjust each lesson using questions and reflections.

use_cases.title: Learn From Existing Project Knowledge
use_cases.description: Review relevant project materials, confirm the learner baseline, and focus new lessons on gaps.

use_cases.title: Turn Selected Materials Into Lessons
use_cases.description: Use specified documents as the starting knowledge base and maintain a continuing course with progress records.

prompt_templates.title: Begin a New Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Teach me probability from zero in Chinese. Confirm the storage directory, then create a learning plan and the first lesson.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start without using project materials to infer prior knowledge.

prompt_templates.title: Continue After Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue my probability topic. Read my latest lesson feedback, summarize my understanding, and use simpler examples for concepts I found unclear.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: adapt the next lesson to written feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm a Project-Based Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me study software architecture. Review a small set of relevant, nonsensitive project materials and present baseline candidates before creating lessons.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: confirm existing knowledge before choosing the learning starting point.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Course From Selected Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only my specified documents for the learning baseline. Reassess the course using my feedback, exclude unconfirmed drafts, and update the plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise an ongoing learning path with explicit source boundaries.

output_examples.input: A new sociology topic has relevant project materials, but the learner has not selected a knowledge baseline.
output: The response, in Chinese, summarizes three to five candidate knowledge points and identifies uncertain assumptions.
It asks the learner to choose project-based learning, starting from zero, or specified materials.
It waits for that choice before creating the plan or first lesson.

output_examples.input: The learner says the previous economics lesson did not make supply and demand curves clear.
output: The response, in Chinese, summarizes the learner's difficulty using the actual feedback.
The next lesson uses concrete examples and slows the pace instead of introducing many new concepts.
The learning plan records the feedback, current progress, and the next direction.

output_examples.input: A project contains useful public notes alongside credentials and private client documents.
output: The workflow reads project rules, indexes, and relevant public material.
It skips sensitive materials unless the user explicitly specifies them.
The baseline summary excludes sensitive filenames, contents, and paths.

best_practices: State the topic, learning goal, storage directory, and preferred knowledge-baseline mode.
Write specific feedback below the latest lesson's feedback prompts, including unclear concepts and desired examples.
Confirm inferred prior knowledge and explicitly limit source materials when working with a mixed project.
anti_patterns: Treating project mentions, AI drafts, or third-party notes as proof that the learner understands a concept.
Requesting the next lesson without feedback while expecting precise adaptation to the learner's understanding.
Using the skill for business diagnosis, standalone ghostwriting, or unrestricted sensitive-document review.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: It targets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Maintaining local learning files requires an environment with file access.

faq.question: What language are the lessons written in?
faq.answer: The skill requires Chinese output for its lessons.

faq.question: Where are learning files stored?
faq.answer: It prefers your chosen directory, then a project learning folder. In general or system directories, it uses a dedicated folder under Documents.

faq.question: Does it assume I understand everything in my project?
faq.answer: No. Project content provides candidate evidence, and the skill distinguishes confirmed knowledge from drafts, third-party materials, and uncertain understanding.

faq.question: What happens when I have not written feedback?
faq.answer: It asks what you understood and what remains unclear. You can request continuation, with a notice that the lesson uses currently visible context.

faq.question: Does it read credentials or private documents?
faq.answer: The instructions exclude credentials and sensitive materials by default. Sensitive content requires explicit user selection, and project access rules still apply.
